input.brief: 企业 AI 人才平台：简历筛选、测评、人才画像、岗位匹配与决策的后台工作台

style.name: Data terminal
style.basis: 1 screen: a stock research view. Keep it narrow.
style.idea: A research or monitoring screen read in long sessions: cards darker than the ground, tabular digits that stack, signs instead of colour, and every selection marked by the same 1px accent line.
style.colourBudget: under 3%; the accent is never more than a 1px line

font.note: Section titles 20/400 in the muted grey; card titles 16/600; tabular figures everywhere.

style.signature: Every selection (tab, toggle, range, nav item) is a 1px accent line exactly as wide as its label, placed on the nearest existing edge; numbers stay white or grey and carry their sign in the text ('+$24,000,000').
identity: Every figure in a monospace as the style's decision (IBM Plex Mono or JetBrains Mono for each price, count and time, digits that stack), with the text in Public Sans. Lint and the inspector flag mono; give the reason in the report.
The one accent line from the product's world in place of the dealt blue (the exchange's or the team's hue): still the only selection mark, never violet or indigo.
A signature of the market or the system as the lead: an order book's depth as two mirrored bar lists, an incident as a minute-by-minute strip, a region map with the list beside it.
avoid: filled pill tabs or a coloured segmented control
a chart with no scale and no dates (the studied screen had none and was flagged)
tertiary text under 4.5:1 (#4c4c4f read at about 2:1 in the study)
lighter cards with borders and a glow
green and red on every number; the one column whose job is "what moved today" and a negative headline figure may carry the polarity colours
style.notes: The studied screen's muted grey #82848a and red #d4405d were lifted to #8a8c92 and #e5566f so text passes 4.5:1 on the card. Its card list rows sit on a 28px pitch and its table rows on 42px.

shell.name: Icon rail

numbers.active: icon colour alone, or a full-bleed 50px band at a 2% tint, or a 1px accent bar on the rail's border
numbers.utilities: pushed to the bottom after a gap of about 200px

shell.blueprint: An unlabelled rail of 50-60px carries the brand mark at the top and 15-18px outline icons on a 34-49px pitch; groups are split by 20px hairlines, utilities sit at the bottom. The rail sits on the page ground with a 1px edge, or is white with a faint 4px shadow on a grey ground. It saves about 180px of width against a labelled sidebar, so it suits products with few destinations and screens that need the width. Icons need tooltips and an accessible name.
shell.phone: The rail becomes a bottom bar with the same four or five icons, each with a short label under it.

pattern.name: Count cards that filter
pattern.blueprint: Above a list, 3-5 equal count cards (61px tall, 12px padding, a 13px grey label over a 16/600 value, 8px gap) are the type filter: the selected card gets a 1.5px accent border and a pale accent fill, and the list below shows that type only. Zero counts print as '0' in the same style; no deltas, no icons. This is one place where a row of identical small cards is right: the cards are peers and each one does work.
pattern.phone: The count cards become a horizontally scrolling row of chips with the count inside each, or a select above the list.

pattern.name: Tabbed object detail in a sheet
pattern.basis: a list's engagement tab; a reports dashboard
pattern.blueprint: Inside the sheet: a breadcrumb row at 16/600 (the parent in grey, the current page as the h1, a 24px grey type chip after it) with its actions on the right (a text button and an outlined 32px dropdown). Under it, the object's tabs at 14px with a 2px ink underline that runs 8px past the label, on a 1px rule that spans the sheet. 30px below, the filter row: a label above a 300x32 select on the left; the freshness stamp ('Last updated July 21, 2026') and a 40px refresh button on the right, centred on the select's line. Then 3 KPI cards (value 36/400, its label at 16/600 under it, the period in words) and 2 chart cards, all on one 24px gutter so the rows share column lines. Do not stretch a short card to its neighbour's height (it left 250px of dead white) and do not list legend series that have no data.
pattern.phone: Breadcrumb shortens to a back link and the h1; tabs scroll; KPI cards stack as label-value rows; charts full width.

pattern.name: Settings in two columns
pattern.basis: one settings page; stacking from a narrow rail card. The basis is thin.
pattern.blueprint: A centred column of about 1152px. Each section is one row: a label column of about 450px (16/500 title, 14px grey description; the title's cap top 6-8px below the panel top, level with the panel's first line) beside a panel of about 700px with a #fafafa fill, 16px radius, 16px padding, no border and no shadow. Sections are split by a full-width 1px rule with 32px above and below. Inside a panel: field labels 14/500 above 40px white inputs (1px #e8e8e8, radius 10), 8px from label to field, 16px between fields, 24px from the description to the first label, 16px to the Save button; switch rows with a 14/500 title, a 20px status badge 8px after it, a 14px grey description and a 28x16 toggle 16px from the right edge, centred on the title line. A plan-gated feature shows a 48px tinted strip with a 32px button directly above its panel, and the panel stays readable. When a panel runs much taller than its label, put the section's help or a summary of the current values in the label column rather than 250px of nothing.
pattern.phone: Each section stacks: title and description, then the panel at full width. Inside, label, 8-10px, field, 16-26px to the next pair; toggles stay on the right of their title.
